high_level_description: This image features a person posing against a plain blue background. The individual is wearing an elegant, long-sleeved white dress adorned with intricate floral patterns and embellishments. The dress has a fitted bodice and a flared skirt that extends to the floor. The person is also wearing black shoes with white socks, adding a contrasting element to the outfit. The person's pose is dynamic; they are lying on their side with one leg extended forward and the other bent at the knee. Their head is turned slightly towards the camera, giving a sense of engagement with the viewer.
